title: Strategic Management
sources_used: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: BYJU’S was founded in 2011 and launched its learning application in 2015. Demand for online education increased sharply during the COVID-19 pandemic, and the company expanded into more than 21 countries while acquiring several education businesses. Its valuation rose from approximately $5 billion before the pandemic to $22 billion in 2022. Difficulties later emerged when the company delayed filing its financial statements for the year ended March 2022; Deloitte resigned as auditor after stating that it had not received the required documents, and three investor representatives left the board. The Board of Control for Cricket in India initiated insolvency proceedings over unpaid sponsorship dues of approximately $19 million, while US lenders claimed that they were owed about $1 billion. In August 2024, India’s Supreme Court revived insolvency proceedings, and Reuters subsequently reported claims exceeding $1.5 billion from 1,887 creditors. Founder Byju Raveendran later acknowledged that the company had entered too many markets too quickly and stated that its value had fallen to zero. (a). Define strategy implementation and list four factors that influence its effectiveness. (b). Explain how the events presented in the BYJU’S case are connected with the implementation of strategy. (c). Assume that you were appointed to lead BYJU’S in 2022 before the crisis became severe. Present the three actions you would have taken first and justify them using information from the case. / [CO3] [1 x 15 = 15] Long Essay A choice between two options for each question, answer two short essay questions, one from each pair, Each question carries 10 marks.
questions.solution_html:
• BYJU'S Case Study Answer [A / CO3]
  • (a) Define Strategy Implementation and 4 Factors Influencing its Effectiveness
  • Strategy Implementation is the process of putting formulated strategy into action. It is converting
  • strategic plans into operational reality through allocation of resources, designing structure,
  • leadership, and control systems. While formulation is  - what to do, implementation is how to do it.
  • Many good strategies fail due to poor implementation - as in BYJU'S case.
